findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done — When a repo upgrades with an already stopped review and no `known` field, `--resolve accept` initializes `known` from the latest review only (close.py:118). Earlier rounds' findings disappear from the item's durable record after squash. Also, accepting a below-bar finding already in `known` leaves its existing outcome and empty reason unchanged because `score.remember` updates only `open` entries (score.py:150). Both paths violate the required carry-forward of findings and acceptance reasons.

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done — `score.read_stops` checks Harm 3 on every note, including one Forge has automatically disposed as below the bar. On a third blocked read with a new at-bar Harm 1 note and a below-bar Harm 3 follow-up, it stops the read loop even though no open note has Harm 3 and no at-bar note is a `Disputed keep`. The stop question then omits the disposed note that triggered the stop.
